info.title: Glide
info.description: Glide's official MCP server. Build, manage, and operate GlideOS apps, data, and workflows from Microsoft Copilot: create and manage projects, query and modify app databases, run workflows, publish and roll back apps, and read, write, and search project files.

post.description: Sends a JSON-RPC 2.0 message to the Glide MCP server over Streamable HTTP. Microsoft Copilot Studio handles MCP session and protocol negotiation; this operation is not intended to be called directly by makers.

401.description: Unauthorized — the OAuth token is missing, expired, or invalid.

403.description: Forbidden — the signed-in Glide account's plan does not include the MCP server feature, or the account lacks permission for the requested resource.

500.description: Internal server error from the Glide MCP server.

error.description: Error message returned by the Glide MCP server.

scopes.REPLACE_WITH_GLIDE_SCOPE: Access GlideOS projects, apps, data, and workflows on behalf of the signed-in user
